notes.worstCaseDepressurization: Intended null. The auditor DEPRESSURIZED the house (to about -50 Pa) only as the METHOD to run the worst-case spillage test; he reports a result for spillage, not a discrete pass/fail on the depressurization test itself. Arguable: a model reading the -50 Pa achievement as a passed depressurization is defensible -- score passed here as a mild reading, not a hallucination. failed/warning are wrong.

notes.gasLeak: A real but small leak at the range shutoff, auditor grades it warning (not failed): borderline, needs a plumber, not evacuate-now. Reading it as failed is a severity error, score per severity.
